name: Blake Richards
topic: Your Brain Built AI (Before Silicon Did)
bio: Blake Richards is an Associate Professor in the School of Computer Science and the Montreal Neurological Institute at McGill University, and a Core Faculty Member at Mila, the Quebec AI Institute. His research sits at the intersection of neuroscience and artificial intelligence, with a focus on the universal principles of intelligence shared by brains and machines. He is a CIFAR Canada AI Chair and recipient of major distinctions including the NSERC Arthur B. McDonald Fellowship and the Canadian Association for Neuroscience Young Investigator Award, and is one of the clearest voices working at the frontier between how minds work and how machines learn.
